text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Whew... I only intended to do some light
solo
training today, but I ended up
running a
substantial distance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
There are so many huge dump trucks
here. I
wonder if they're doing
construction work.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I used to love
watching the
dump trucks at
construction sites when I was
young...

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Whoa, awesome! It's so big and strong!

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text:
Mommy! When I grow up, I want to be a
dump
truck!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I must admit that was quite a peculiar
aspiration...
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Still, a dump truck's design cannot be
faulted.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The solid center of gravity allows it to
handle
massive loads of soil and sand
without issue.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And it can remain perfectly stable even
when the
dump bed tilts to empty out its
contents.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There are striking similarities
between dump
trucks and the
defense-focused Kongo Yaegaki
style!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I instinctively sensed that as a
child and
came to admire the trucks for
that reason.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hm, yes. In the future, I'll endeavor to
embody
the strength and stability of a
dump truck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From that day forward, Yaeno Muteki's
running
feels more sturdy somehow.
